metadata.description: Check a repo for booby traps before your AI coding tool opens or installs it.

plugins.name: repo-trust-check
plugins.description: The safety skill: when you paste a repo link, your AI downloads it into a quarantine folder, scans it offline, and explains the verdict before anything runs.

plugins.name: repo-trust-check-hook
plugins.description: Optional and stricter: blocks plain `git clone` / `gh repo clone` commands so they must go through the safety check. Installs the skill too.
